name: ops-chain-observer
description: Per-chain detailed fused observation. Distinct from upstream ops-analyst (which samples across many loops); this role wakes once per dev-via-spec chain at the qa-reviewer terminal, walks the entire chain's loop graph, and emits a coherent end-to-end diagnosis. ADR-027 Phase 1 read-only contract; rule-triggered request/response per session. Chain.paused observation is a follow-up (chainpause emits chain.paused.* triples directly today).
